edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a protective direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: EMDR is thought to help by coupling traumatic memory recall with structured bilateral stimulation, which can lower memory vividness and distress during reconsolidation.
edges.summary: For post-traumatic stress disorder, the most useful starting point is the 2022 Molero-Zafra rct in Int J Environ Res Public Health. It found that eye movement desensitisation and reprocessing tracks with lower risk or better outcomes, and the follow-on evidence is broadly consistent even when absolute benefit or harm is modest.
edges.caveats: Healthier-user bias, screening intensity, and baseline risk can all inflate apparent benefit in observational work, so the magnitude should be read conservatively.
